lanes.summary: The diff fails to uphold the formal property it adds to the contract (NT-INV-005) and the explicitly stated acceptance criteria. While it correctly prints the lane table for successful/judged runs, a crashed run (which still constitutes a "run" with a writable stdout) continues to print exactly one line and does not write `D/lanes.txt`, mathematically violating the new invariant formula `|stdout(run)| = 2 + |lanes|`.

findings.fix: A crashed run (such as one failing the `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN` check or hitting the rate limit) exits via `on_exit` and prints exactly one line (the failure verdict), completely omitting the lane table from stdout and failing to write `D/lanes.txt`. This mathematically violates the updated `NT-INV-005` formal property and the AC "every run writes D/lanes.txt". The contract and AC must be restricted to successful/judged runs, or the table must be populated even during early crashes.
